summary: Full backend (18 pytest, all pass) + frontend E2E (Playwright, 2 users) of habit tracker. All requested flows verified: signup/signin/signout redirects, wrong-password error, unauth redirect to /signin, top-nav + sidebar navigation, add private (default unticked) / shared habits with Private/Shared badges, habit page 7 local-date checkboxes (today..today-6), tick/untick persists after reload, Days done and Current streak correct (today+yday=2; +3 days ago keeps 2; untick today -> 1), community shows only shared habits with owner/when/days done, private habit 'Habit not found' for other user (API 404), non-owner checkboxes disabled and PUT 403, comment posting with author name visible to owner. No bugs found.

issues: Ticked day checkbox shows only a tiny white dot as checkmark inside red box - checkmark glyph barely visible (cosmetic)

action_items: Optional: make ticked checkbox checkmark more visible
critical_code_review_comments: Brute-force lockout keyed on request.client.host which behind ingress is the proxy IP, effectively per-email lockout (acceptable, but consider X-Forwarded-For)
Streak counts back from most recent done day (per spec), not from today - matches requirement
Auth uses Bearer token in localStorage instead of httpOnly cookies (by design per E1 note); CORS allow_credentials=False consistent with that
seed_data_creation: Test users (test_*, ui_*, ui2_* emails) and their habits/comments were created and then deleted from DB; login_attempts cleared
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest /app/backend/tests/test_habit_tracker.py with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL exported. Tests create their own users via signup. Avoid wrong-password attempts on alice (5-fail lockout).
